bank_connection_sync_cursor_chk.name: bank_connection_sync_cursor_chk
bank_connection_sync_cursor_chk.value: "bank_connection"."sync_cursor" is null or (char_length("bank_connection"."sync_cursor") between 1 and 8192 and "bank_connection"."sync_cursor" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

recurring_item_second_day_chk.name: recurring_item_second_day_chk
recurring_item_second_day_chk.value: ("recurring_item"."cadence" = 'semimonthly') = ("recurring_item"."second_day_of_month" is not null) and ("recurring_item"."second_day_of_month" is null or "recurring_item"."second_day_of_month" between 1 and 31)

recurring_item_tolerance_chk.name: recurring_item_tolerance_chk
recurring_item_tolerance_chk.value: "recurring_item"."tolerance_percent" between 0 and 50 and "recurring_item"."tolerance_cents" between 0 and 10000000 and "recurring_item"."window_days" between 0 and 10

recurring_item_dates_chk.name: recurring_item_dates_chk
recurring_item_dates_chk.value: "recurring_item"."end_date" is null or "recurring_item"."start_date" is null or "recurring_item"."end_date" >= "recurring_item"."start_date"

transaction_bank_identity_chk.name: transaction_bank_identity_chk
transaction_bank_identity_chk.value: ("transaction"."bank_provider_id" is null and "transaction"."bank_account_ref" is null and "transaction"."bank_transaction_id" is null) or ("transaction"."bank_provider_id" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$' and char_length("transaction"."bank_account_ref") between 1 and 200 and char_length("transaction"."bank_transaction_id") between 1 and 200)

transaction_bank_match_chk.name: transaction_bank_match_chk
transaction_bank_match_chk.value: ("transaction"."bank_matched_at" is null and "transaction"."bank_occurred_on" is null and "transaction"."bank_payee" is null) or "transaction"."bank_transaction_id" is not null
